notes: The end-to-end example CI runs; keep it working.
question: What should I tell them about the VPN?
text: Approved VPN requests are provisioned in the nightly run at 02:00 UTC, so an approval from yesterday afternoon should be live this morning -- if it is not, the approval did not land. There is no expedited path for the 14:00 call; suggest dialing in without VPN if the client allows it.
